doc: CONTROL for iron-a: the old fixed craft quota of 6 (the one that hid iron_pickaxe). Iron isolation (owner 2026-11-04): why does the agent not get past iron? The kit holds 1 stack of cobblestone, 2 stone pickaxes, 1 stack of sticks, 5 crafting tables and 8 coal (the fuel; `smelt` loads it into the furnace itself, so a furnace 'loaded with fuel' is a furnace plus coal in the inventory). Iron is a connected cluster of 3 to 5 ore blocks on the surface, so the 3 ingots of an iron pickaxe are always there. No hostile mob spawns and a death gives the kit back. Only the iron-tier entries pay (collect_iron, smelt_iron, craft_iron_pickaxe, craft_iron_sword); every other entry is shown as already reached, nothing else is paid (survival, death, invalid-command terms weigh 0). A: the bot stands in front of the iron (2-3 blocks, within 15 degrees of its heading) and holds a furnace item and the fuel: no walking, no station to build or find.
